roga:
[Ruja+ṇa]  CL=9 1. Physical and Mental Diseases:
- Kāyika roga (physical illness)
- Cetasika roga (mental illness)
2. Metaphorical Diseases:
- Kāmaguṇa (sensual pleasures as disease)
- Avijjā (ignorance as disease)
- Taṇhā (craving as disease)
3. Existential Diseases:
- The five aggregates (khandhas) as disease
- Kilesas (defilements) as disease
- Dukkha-vedanā (painful feelings)
- Saññā (perception)
4. Characteristics:
- Pīḷanaṭṭhena roga (afflicting nature)
- Ābādhaṭṭhena roga (oppressing nature)
- Ārogyavilambanaṭṭhena roga (opposing health)
- Rujjanaṭṭhena roga (breaking/painful nature)
Etymology and Grammatical Analysis:
- Root: √ruj (break, cause pain)
- 'rujatīti roga' - that which causes pain/breaking is called disease
- 'rujjatīti roga' - that which is broken/painful is called disease

ropita: [Ruha+ṇe+ta] (ti) CL=7 [Ropita-saṃ. Rovia-prā.] (1) Should be put (A) Kamma, (2) Anger which is sin. (2) Should cultivate/grow (A) Seed, (B) Plant (or) Tree, (C) Merit. (3) Should establish/place (saddā). (4) (Place,Department) where is to grow/plant. See - Ropayati. See also - Ropitaṭhāna.
ropitavana: [Ropita+vana] (na) CL=7 Forest which should be planted.
ropitaṭhāna: [Ropita+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 Planted place (or) A place where is planted (such as a tree).
ropāpana: [Ruha+ṇe+ṇāpe+yu] (na) CL=7 [Two Kāriukapaccaññaḥ]. Let him grow/plant. See also - Ropayati.
ropāpenta: [Ruha+ṇe+ṇāpe+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who makes him to cultivate.
ropāpessanti: [Ruha+ṇe+ṇāpe+ssanti] (kā,kri) CL=7 [Ruha+ṇe+ṇāpe+uuṃ. Uuṃ-kiu ssanti-pru. Rodissati - See]. They have been planted. See also - Ropayati.
ropāpetabba: [Ruha+ṇe+ṇāpe+tabba] (ti) CL=7 [Two Kārakapaccaya] It should be cultivated/planted.
ropāpeti: [Ruha+ṇe+ṇāpe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 [Two Kāriukapaccaññaḥ] Let them to cultivate/plant.
ropāpetvā: [Ruha+ṇe+ṇāpe+tvā] (kā,kri,vi) CL=7 (1) Having sowed seeds to get seedlings. (2) Having planted/cultivated.
roruka: [Ani] (na) CL=7 [Pāṭi. Rorukasakkatapiṭaka. Purāṇamrepuṃ-176. It is bank of Indu river in Parkistan Country]. Roruka City.
roruva: [Ru+a] (pu,na) CL=7 [Moga,5.7va nirutti.597. Ruru+aṇa. Amara,ṭī. It finishes form as Lolupa, momūha words. Bhusaṃ, punappunaṃ vā dukkhitasaddena ravanti asmiṃ roruvo. Dhāna,ṭī,657.(saṃ,ṭṭha,1.77. Jā,ṭṭha,5,288). Rorava-saṃ. Rorua-prā, addhamāgadhī.] (1) Roruva hell. (2) Roruva King. (3) Roruva City. See original.
rosajanaka: [Rosa+janaka] (ti) CL=7 One who causes anger (or) One who is exceedingly wrathful.
rosaka: [Rusa+ṇvu.thī-] (ti) CL=7 [Rosikā. Ropaka-saṃ.]  (1) Can speak ill of a person/slander. (2) Can be anger (with body and mind). Rosaka(ti) [rosa+ṇvu. Nīti,dhātu.184.] One who fears.
rosana: [Rusa+yu] (ti) CL=7 [Ropaṇa-saṃ. Rosaṇa-prā.] (Ti) (1) One who used to repress/oppress. One who is anger. (Thi. Na) (2) Oppression/ Repression (A) Beat (or) Strike. (B) Speak ill of a person (or) Slander.
rosaneyya: [Rusa+anīya] (ti) CL=7 Should be oppressed and slandered.
rosanta: [Rusa+anta] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī  rosantī.] One who oppresses and slanders.
rosati: [Rusa+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 [Ropati-saṃ. Rosai-prā.] One who oppresses, slanders and uses excessively obscene language. See - Rosanti, roseti. Rosati(kri) [rosa+a+ti. Nīti,dhātu.184.] Fear. Rosati(kri) [rusa+ṇe+ti. Nīti,dhātu.346. Ropayati-saṃ(kā,kri).] Be oppressive (A) Slander. (B) To be anger. (C) Torture and distroy.
rosaye: [Rusa+ṇaya+eyya] (kri) CL=7 Should be oppressive and slander.
rosenti: [Rusa+ṇe+anti] (kri) CL=7 They used excessively obscene language. See also - Roseti.
rosesi: [Rusa+ṇe+si] (kri) CL=7 (You) are oppressive and slander. Rosesi(kri) [rusa+ṇe+ī. Sa-āguṃ.] Having oppressed, Be angry.
rosessāma: [Rusa+ṇe+ssāma] (kri) CL=7 Will be oppressive, Will speak ill of a person.
rosetha: [Rusa+ṇe+tha] (kri) CL=7 Let them to speak ill of a person.
rosetu: [Rusa+ṇe+tu] (ti) CL=7 [Roṭa-saṃ.] Can be oppressive and slander.
rosetukāma: [Rosetuṃ+kamu+ṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who wants to oppress. Desires to oppress. See also - Roseti.
rosetukāmatā: [Rosetukāma+tā] (thī) CL=7 As one who wants to oppress.
rosetvā: [Rusa+ṇe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having oppressed and slandered, Having felt anger.
roseyyuṃ: [Rusa+ṇe+eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They are oppressed and slandered.
rosikā: [Rusa+ṇvu] (thī) CL=7 (Barber) named Rosikā. See also - Rosaka.
rosita: [Rusa+ṇe+ta] (ti) CL=7 [Ropita-saṃ. Rosia-prā.] Should be oppressed and slandered. Rosita(ti) [rusa+ta. Rupīta-saṃ.]  Should be applied/smeared.
rocesu: [Ruca+ṇe+uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 It is liked and wanted.
roceyyu: [Ruca+ṇe+eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 It would be liked and wanted.
roddhu: [Rudhi(rudha)+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 [ From - Rundhati] To prohibit (or) To forbid.
rodeyyu: [Ruda+a+eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They will weep loudly, They have been wept loudly.
roditu: [Ruda+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 [Come from I- alphabet]. To cry (or) To weep. See also - Rudati.
ropayi: [Ruha+ṇaya+iṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 (1) (I) have planted. (2) (I) have donated. See also - Ropayati.
ropissa: [Ruha+ṇe+ssaṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 (I) will cultivate. See also - Ropayati.
roseyyu: [Rusa+ṇe+eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They are oppressed and slandered.
